annotations.title: Get a link to upload a file

description: A one-time link that takes one picture or video (PNG, JPEG, WebP or MP4), for a file you made or hold where sending it whole in media_upload is not practical, such as a picture drawn in your own sandbox. Send the bytes to url with PUT and its Content-Type, no sign-in needed; the answer is its media id. Where you cannot reach the web, give the user the file and the link: they open it, pick the file and press Upload; then media_list has it under the name you gave the link. One file per link; it ends after an hour. Nothing is posted. Make a picture a JPEG: every network that takes pictures accepts JPEG, while Instagram refuses PNG and WebP (capabilities lists each network’s mediaTypes).

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name.description: A file name for the user’s own list. Taken from the file when left out.
